Animation Items Demos

These demos show scroll-driven animations on individual items using the animate attribute.
Scroll down to see elements animate as they enter the viewport.

<lay-out animate="bounce() trigger-both slow" lg="columns(3)">

Reveal Animations — shapes

Clip-path endpoints come from the shared --shp-* catalog (ui/base/shapes.css), so the same shape pair can drive a static media clip and a reveal. reveal(circle), reveal(inset), reveal(polygon) and reveal(superellipse) are container-only — they have an [animate-self] arm but no child arm; see animate-self.html.

reveal(hex) trigger-both

Items reveal from a hexagon.

<lay-out animate="reveal(hex) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

reveal(star) trigger-both

Items reveal from a star.

<lay-out animate="reveal(star) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

reveal(rhomb) trigger-both

Items reveal from a rhombus.

<lay-out animate="reveal(rhomb) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

reveal(plus) trigger-both

Items reveal from a plus.

<lay-out animate="reveal(plus) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

reveal(circ) trigger-both

Items reveal from a circle.

<lay-out animate="reveal(circ) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

Animation Multipliers

Use a multiplier (1–3) to control animation intensity. Default is 1×.

fade-up — Default vs 2× vs 3×

2× intensity (220px translation).

<lay-out animate="fade-up(2) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

3× intensity (330px translation).

<lay-out animate="fade-up(3) trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

Custom Easings

Apply custom easings to item animations with the easing attribute. 81 values ship — 12 families in 5 steps each plus 21 named curves (ui/base/easings.css, wired in ui/base/animate.css):

ease-1…5 · ease-in-1…5 · ease-out-1…5 · ease-in-out-1…5 · ease-spring-1…5 · ease-bounce-1…5 · ease-elastic-1…5 · ease-elastic-in-1…5 · ease-elastic-out-1…5 · ease-elastic-in-out-1…5 · ease-squish-1…5 · ease-step-1…5
Named curves in -in / -out / -in-out triples: ease-quad-* · ease-cubic-* · ease-quart-* · ease-quint-* · ease-sine-* · ease-expo-* · ease-circ-*

slide-in() trigger-both with easing="ease-elastic-1"

Items slide in with elastic overshoot.

<lay-out animate="slide-in() trigger-both" easing="ease-elastic-1" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-spring-1"

Items spring up gently.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-spring-1" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-3"

Standard curve, mid step.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-3" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-in-out-3"

Symmetric acceleration and deceleration.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-in-out-3" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-spring-3"

Springy overshoot.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-spring-3" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-bounce-3"

Bounces at the end.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-bounce-3" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-elastic-3"

Elastic wobble.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-elastic-3" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both with easing="ease-squish-3"

Squash and stretch.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" easing="ease-squish-3" lg="columns(3)">

Trigger Direction

Control whether triggered animations play on entry, exit, or both. Uses trigger (entry), trigger-exit (exit only), or trigger-both (entry + exit).

fade-up() trigger

Items fade up on entry — stay visible on exit.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-exit

Items animate only when scrolling out of view.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-exit" lg="columns(3)">

fade-up() trigger-both

Items fade up on entry, reverse on exit.

<lay-out animate="fade-up() trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

zoom-in() trigger-both

Items zoom in on entry, reverse on exit.

<lay-out animate="zoom-in() trigger-both" lg="columns(3)">

flip-up() trigger-exit

Items flip only when scrolling out of view.

<lay-out animate="flip-up() trigger-exit" lg="columns(3)">

Stagger shorthand — stagger

The same simple fade/slide/zoom reveals, written with the shared stagger vocabulary instead of animate="fade-up()". Scroll-driven by default — progress is tied to scroll position, so it re-runs every time you scroll back and forth. Add trigger for a one-shot that plays once and stays (Chrome 145+; older browsers keep the re-running reveal). The richer animate= effects above (flip, bounce, deep, exit, stack, pace, easing) have no stagger token and stay as animate=.
Token map: rise→fade-up · fall→fade-down · lft→fade-left · rgt→fade-right · zom→zoom-in · fde→fade-in · blr→blur (no animate= twin). For horizontal carousels see overflow.html.

stagger (default = rise, scroll-driven, re-runs)

Each card fades up as it scrolls through the viewport — scroll back up and it reverses.

<lay-out stagger lg="columns(3)">

stagger="rise trigger" — one-shot (plays once, stays)

Same reveal, but trigger plays it once on entry and does not reverse on scroll-back.

<lay-out stagger="rise trigger" lg="columns(3)">

stagger="zom"

Cards scale up from the inline-start.

<lay-out stagger="zom" lg="columns(3)">

stagger="blr"

Cards sharpen into focus — no animate= equivalent.

<lay-out stagger="blr" lg="columns(3)">

Layout Patterns — Item Animation

Item animation (animate=) composes with any layout mode, not just columns.

Bento Layout with Item Animation

A bento box layout with zoom-in item animations.

<lay-out animate="zoom-in()" lg="bento(6a)">
